cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll serve. I've made you soup; the choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit. Take my bread too; I can't swallow yet.

reason: Preserve the seed core that enacts both cards through meal control and yielding to B seating request; remove status boilerplate and the loose ask-twice clause.
